# ncurses

<!-- EGM_BLUEPRINT_START: AUTO-GENERATED BY egm-bootstrap. PUT HUMAN NOTES ABOVE THIS LINE -->
## Overview

Platform-specific upstream ncurses patch inputs.
## Interface

- `patch-cxx_cursesf.h:NCursesUserForm` and `patch-cxx_cursesm.h:NCursesUserMenu` change pointer-array constructors; `patch-ncurses_tinfo_lib__baudrate.c` adjusts OpenBSD headers/version guards.
- `ncurses-5.9-gcc-5.patch:MKlib_gen.sh`, `ncurses-clang.patch`, patch-aa through patch-ad and the Solaris detection patch alter upstream generation/configuration/build files.
## Invariants

- `config/software/ncurses.rb:build` gates these patches by platform/version; patch filenames and strip levels must match that caller. These are patch fragments, not standalone C/C++ headers.
## Side Effects

- When applied by ncurses.rb, patches modify the extracted upstream build tree; patch files themselves perform no runtime I/O.
## Verification

From the `omnibus-software` repository root after installing the Gemfile dependencies: `bundle exec rake test` loads all software definitions; `bundle exec rake style` checks Ruby style. Full platform builds are separate and execute the build side effects above.
